newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA LEV EASES TO 227.20/50 TO DOLLAR AT CLOSE.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA LEV EASES TO 227.20/50 TO DOLLAR AT CLOSE.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev traded in very low volumes at 227.20/50 per dollar at the close of the local interbank market, softer than 226.20/227 in the morning due to a small rise in dollar demand, dealers said.
"(Foreign currency) demand slightly topped supply in the afternoon and the lev eased to 227.20/50 per by the end of the trade despite dollar sales by the central bank," one dealer said.

The central bank sold dollars to several commercial banks between 226 and 227 levs amid moderate demand, which to a great extent determined today's relative stability of the exchange rate, dealers said.
The national currency can be expected to retreat by at least 2-3 levs against the dollar tomorrow due to the longer value date of spot deals, traders said.
"The lev however may ease even further if the central bank halts its dollar sales," a dealer said. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
